title: Launch orchestration playset — Sales & CS enablement assets
creator: Liam Chen
description:
Goal: Deliver a concise, field-ready enablement playset for Sales and Customer Success to support the runtime-1.21 launch. The playset should make it trivial for reps and CSMs to run demos, answer common security/compliance questions, and position cost/latency benefits versus alternatives.

Scope/Deliverables (minimum viable):
- 1-page battlecard (key value props, target personas, objection handlers, competitive differentiators).
- FAQ (20+ prioritized Qs with short/long answers; compliance and deployment permutations included).
- Two talk-track scripts: a 3-minute elevator script and a 12-minute discovery/demo script.
- Demo script + checklist for the standard qbatch/prefix-cache demo flow with expected prompts, success criteria, and common failure-mode workarounds.
- A short slide deck (6 slides) for discovery calls and internal rehearsal.
- Two recorded demo walkthroughs (live host + narration, and a trimmed 90s highlight reel).
- Release notes coordination summary for Sales and CS: one-paragraph changelog + 3 callouts for messaging.

Acceptance criteria:
- All artifacts reviewed and approved by Sales Enablement and CS leadership.
- Release notes snippet confirmed with Docs and included in customer-facing release notes.
- Demo validated against staging runtime-1.21 environment (ENG sign-off).
- Assets uploaded to Drive + Confluence with clear naming and versioning.

Cross-team owners and contacts:
- PM (owner): Liam Chen (product-management) — overall sign-off and messaging alignment.
- Sales Enablement: Ava Martinez — primary reviewer and roll-out lead.
- CS Enablement: Priya Nair — customer-facing playbook validation.
- Docs: Mateo Ruiz — release notes and canonical FAQ source.
- Engineering: Noor Patel — staging demo environment and acceptance tests.
- Design/Content: Sienna Park — slide and script polish.

Notes on release notes coordination:
- Draft changelog paragraph created and posted to Confluence (see attachments). Must be synchronized with Docs PR before 2026-03-15 to meet public release window.
- Two customer-facing callouts required: (1) latency/cost benchmarks summary; (2) Dedicated/Private compatibility notes. Engineering will provide benchmark artifacts by 2026-03-09.

Storage & distribution:
- Canonical assets live in Drive folder and mirrored to Confluence page. Sales playbook snapshot will be copied to the Sales triage Slack channel and pinned.

Risks/mitigations:
- Last-minute behavioral/regression in runtime could break demo scripts — mitigation: include a fallback demo using runtime-1.20 model pinned via smart-routing with clear instructions.
- Legal/compliance questions on private deployments — mitigation: get Legal sign-off on the FAQ subset flagged as "legal-sensitive".

Next steps (first 7 days):
1) Draft battlecard + elevator talk track (owner: Ava) — due 2026-03-05.
2) Engineering to deliver benchmark artifact + staging access (owner: Noor) — due 2026-03-09.
3) Docs to sync release notes paragraph and QA the FAQ (owner: Mateo) — due 2026-03-12.
4) Record demo walkthroughs and upload (owner: Sienna + Ava) — due 2026-03-15.

Where to find artifacts: see attachments below for Confluence, Drive, and GitHub links.
